evidence: Reviewed only row 19. Frozen solution/solve.sh:1-6 and 37-38 uses a valid LF bash shebang, resolves its source directory, and copies all app files to /app; its only mutable install targets are /app. No writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, no pkill, and no NODE_ENV=production. Runtime contract is environment/instructions/integration.md:5-13. solution/app/server.js:7-8 resolves assets and default DB from __dirname and honors DB_PATH; :12 serves health; :130-131 serves bundled public assets; :142 listens on 0.0.0.0 at the supplied port; :147-168 uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and INSERT OR IGNORE without duplicate seed rows. The seed supplies zero snippets. Actual independent run: python -B qc/runs/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r2/per-row-review/evidence/19/runtime.py, logged in evidence/19/runtime.json (SHA256 444997cb86911ee54acc697ad61eae692b1c3c1b4273fb48fa4517ed2196b37d), used isolated cw-h2-r19-runtime from image sha256:001e7d851703c4bdda8e84ad85377bb1118009fa9333be4ad3e47b8accdc3230 with frozen solution mounted read-only. bash -n and solve.sh both exited 0; every one of the 15 installed solution files matched frozen bytes. Launch used uid/gid 65534, env -i, CWD=/tmp, HOME=/tmp/row19-home, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000 and node /app/server.js. No local node_modules: global Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 sufficed. Health, /, both bundled assets and runner.html served successfully. Custom nested DB_PATH created the intended file without /app/app.db; create/update/restore produced 3 revisions. After full Docker restart, the record and all 3 revisions matched exactly and replaying the recognized restore did not append another revision. A separate default-path launch created /app/app.db with an empty library and no /tmp/app.db. evidence/19/controls.json (SHA256 7569a0b73a5eea95203a3e2b3f0c1202857268bfdb251223ff4bbd97943d3e5f) records Chromium startup with a real CodeMirror editor, Run/Stop/Save/New/Clear controls and zero page errors. Tested plausible broken control: only the isolated installed copy was changed from __dirname to process.cwd(); health still returned 200 but / returned 404, so a health-only proof would be insufficient and the row-19 test rejected this layout bug. Tested conforming alternative: /app/server.js required a nested server.js with co-located public files, using an independent HOME and /tmp CWD; Chromium loaded the same editor without errors. Internal route/file layout is therefore not imposed as a hidden bar. Both isolated containers were removed; shared golden was untouched. evidence/19/source-verification.json verifies all frozen task/rule hashes plus the four current policy/context files against the manifest (81 matches, zero mismatches). The existing full-install-binding.json hash 3f7625cf8e877dcb70c1ff64308aa8ccc6381a191e59a66c041384f90606600e matched the raw index and its entire expected solution hash map matched this snapshot. Internal workbook D20 contains historical offline wording; current Quality Checks D20 and SKILL delivery profile explicitly permit public network installs and control the interpretation. Limits: these are actual isolated runtime/browser smoke measurements and manual source review, not a private deterministic checker execution, configured judge result, Oracle grade or portal pass. Browser driver import and exact-label mistakes in two preliminary attempts are retained in controls-tooling-failure.json and controls-selector-failure.json; correcting the reviewer driver to use installed Playwright and the observed Run keyboard-shortcut label resolved both without changing frozen source. No unresolved row-19 defect or required row-19 measurement gap remains.
